title: Judgment
description: Derived from ISSUE_FORMAT.md 0.6; the document wins. One judgment in the verification agent's report (section 4.2): one or more issues that share the same verdict, and the reason.
$comment: Derived from ISSUE_FORMAT.md 0.6; the document wins. Not expressed here: that each issue id names an issue of the agent's packet, that rule 1 gives the agent that issue to judge, and that an issue gets one verdict (4.2 rules 1 and 4). A judgment never closes an issue and never changes whether it blocks (4.2 rule 3).

issue_ids.description: One or more issues sharing the same verdict.

verdict.description: uncertain is routed like confirmed (4.2 rule 4).

reason.description: One sentence. A rejection's reason is shown in the question (4.2 rule 6).

issue_id.description: An issue id: ISS-001 and so on (Issue format 4). Written by software, never by an agent.

examples.reason: the methods text names the vessel
